definitions.explanation: A building or development that combines multiple functions such as retail, office, residential, and entertainment spaces under one roof.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}ができた。
examples.english: A mixed-use complex was built in front of the station.

examples.japanese: この{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}には{映画館|えいがかん}や{図書館|としょかん}がある。
examples.english: This complex has a cinema and a library.

examples.japanese: {商業|しょうぎょう}と{住宅|じゅうたく}が{一体|いったい}となった{大型|おおがた}{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}が{来年|らいねん}{完成|かんせい}する。
examples.english: A large mixed-use complex combining commercial and residential spaces will be completed next year.

notes:
A compound of {複合|ふくごう} (composite, combined) and {施設|しせつ} (facility). Refers to buildings or developments that house multiple types of functions — such as retail, office, residential, cultural, and entertainment spaces — under one roof or in one development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}: large mixed-use complex
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}: commercial complex
- {複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}の{建設|けんせつ}: construction of a complex
- {複合施設|ふくごうしせつ}の{開発|かいはつ}: development of a complex

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}: commercial facility — focused solely on retail and commercial use
- ショッピングモール: shopping mall — primarily retail-focused
- {多目的施設|たもくてきしせつ}: multi-purpose facility — a single facility that can be used for different purposes, rather than multiple facilities combined
